title: Checkout reservation
goal: Show reservation before payment and a stock exception.

rubric.must: Reserve items visibly occurs before Authorize.
An alt frame separates available and unavailable stock.
Available branch creates Order after payment approval.
Checkout and Inventory have activation bars.
A note says Reservation precedes charge.
